results.title: Framed Bodyguard Sneaks Onto a Slave Ship Alone To Hunt The 20 Mercenaries Who Killed His Boss
results.author: Fantastic Captain
results.text: A single deal set everything that followed in motion. Cole Reed walked the KMG Bangkok lobby like a man on duty. Beside him, the buyer, Tibo Kempalo, paused at the ship models. The buyer promised he would take great care of the company. Tibo believed him and that trust would cost him everything. He told both men they would make it official in a week. That evening, Tibo and Cole played chess in the study. Over the board, the old man treated Cole like family. Cole admitted he missed the action, but not the politics. He had burned the wrong bridges, he said, and paid for it. Tibo mentioned that today would have been Cole's father's birthday. Cole thanked him quietly for remembering. Alone later, Cole whispered a quiet birthday to his dead father. The next night at the celebration party, Tibo took the microphone. He spoke of ethics over profit with a practiced, easy smile. He boasted of the cleanest record on the high seas. Cole noticed a stranger, an exporter named Denilis, watching from the crowd. Tibo praised Cameron for helping make the sale happen. Cameron looked down and offered nothing in return. Tibo gave Cole a gold Rolex engraved with a date. The date marked the day Tibo had saved Cole's life. 5 years earlier, Cole had taken a bullet meant for him. They embraced and Tibo called him family in front of everyone.
